messages:
alex chen: hey team, just finished Okta SSO but I don't see my Google Drive or company email alias yet. only personal gmail is showing. who should I ping for a temporary folder?

carmen (it): @alex chen can you paste the email you used to signup? sometimes our provisioning strips dots from aliases and that breaks the GSuite mapping.

alex chen: signed up with alex.chen@personaldomain.com -> invited as alexchen@redwood.ai per the invite email. maybe that's the problem.

it-ops-bot: New user provisioning queued for alexchen@redwood.ai — step 2 (groupsync) pending. Estimated completion: ~15m.

carmen (it): yep, looks like the dot got removed during okta->gws mapping. groupsync hasn't picked up the alias yet. i can hand-add you to a temp folder in the meantime. what's your preferred team drive? devx-shared or infra-ops-temp?

taylor: devx-shared is fine for onboarding docs. alex, i can drop a starter folder and share view/edit now if you want.

alex chen: devx-shared please, thanks. also 1Password seat hasn't shown up for me either (can't access team vault).

carmen (it): two things: 1) i'll add you to devx-shared manually. 2) 1Password seat is a license attach in our admin — i'll trigger it now. if it still fails, @marco from identity can force-link your account.

marco: on it. can you confirm your okta username? looks like we have alexchen@redwood.ai and alex.chen@redwood.ai as separate identities during a previous alias merge. which one did you accept the invite as?

alex chen: accepted the invite for alexchen@redwood.ai (the invite email showed that).

marco: thanks. i'm going to run a quick reconcile. if groupsync doesn't match, i'll temporarily add alexchen to the devx group and attach the 1p seat.

it-ops-bot: Provisioning update for alexchen@redwood.ai — groupsync completed, Google Drive groups updated.

carmen (it): added you to devx-shared and invited to 1Password team. you should see invites in your email and the console.

alex chen: got the Drive link, can access docs. 1Password invite arrived too — thanks! :tada:

irene (hr): welcome again @alex chen — reaching out to schedule intro sync. ping me when you have a moment.

alex chen: will do, thanks all. quick note for docs: maybe add a note about alias dot-normalization to the onboarding checklist so new hires don't get blocked.

taylor: good call — filing a tiny PR to onboarding repo after this.

marco: filing a short identity runbook entry as well (alias canonicalization and manual steps).

alex chen: awesome. leaving this thread open in case anything else pops up.

it-ops-bot: Thread closed: provisioning complete.
